name: pypy-review-toolkit
description: Static review toolkit for PyPy's own RPython-level implementation: translated-vs-untranslated divergence, JIT immutability-contract mismatches, interp/app boundary leaks, RPython-restriction hazards, GC hint discipline, JIT driver contract checking, reachability-weighted scanning, and coverage mapping.

plugins.name: pypy-review-toolkit
plugins.description: 11 agents and 6 commands for reviewing PyPy's RPython interpreter core, object space, JIT, and lib_pypy for translation hazards and correctness bugs specific to how PyPy is built.
